name: Solar Discernment grants crit and expertise rating from Intellect natively (#687)
contract: Spell.dbc 807654 ("Solar Discernment", SpellFamilyName 33, Passive) has two effects, both SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT (220) with EffectBasePoints 11 (amount 12, DieSides 1: no randomness) and EffectMiscValueB 3 (STAT_INTELLECT). Effect 0's EffectMiscValue is 1792 = (1<<8)|(1<<9)|(1<<10) = CR_CRIT_MELEE|CR_CRIT_RANGED|CR_CRIT_SPELL ("critical strike rating"); effect 1's is 8388608 = 1<<23 = CR_EXPERTISE ("expertise rating"). AuraEffect::HandleModRatingFromStat (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5035) only triggers a recalculation; Player::UpdateRating (PlayerUpdates.cpp:650-661) does the actual math for every SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT aura on the player: amount += CalculatePct(GetStat(stat), auraAmount). Both effects share the same amount (12) and stat (Intellect), so all four combat ratings this passive touches must come out numerically identical once learned; the scenario validator only allows relative_to/ratio_to between snapshots of the same metric, so this cross-rating equality (rather than a live ratio against Intellect) is what pins the shared 12%-of-Intellect coefficient. This is a fully native, generic engine path: no server script exists or is needed.
